headline: Minister Kacır: We Will Continue to Stand by Our Industrialists and Producers and Support Them
summary: Turkish Industry and Technology Minister Mehmet Fatih Kacır said the ministry will cover 12 points of financing costs for businesses that keep average employment steady from January to June during July-December. The annual rate on fixed-cost loans is 25 percent.
why: Government-backed loan subsidies affect borrowing costs for manufacturers and exporters, and their employment conditions shape corporate cash flow in Turkey's industrial sector.
